title: Diagnostics echo untrusted input: JSON parse messages and unknown property names
resolution: Fixed diagnostic for unparsable lines, unknown property names never printed, and only the secret diagnostic when a secret is found.

title: The glob list splits nested braces such as src/{a,{b,c}}.ts
resolution: splitList tracks brace depth; tested through parseCommand and matchesQuery.

title: The text pattern allows C1 controls and Unicode line separators
resolution: The shared text pattern also forbids U+0080-U+009F, U+2028, and U+2029.

title: URL credentials in the username alone are not detected
resolution: Any non-empty URL user information is treated as secret-like.

title: A test pins exactly 15 categories, contradicting the extensible vocabulary
resolution: The test asserts the seeded categories, and a new test extends the vocabulary by one line.

title: The AWS key pattern misses the ASIA prefix
resolution: The pattern matches AKIA and ASIA keys.

title: The vocabulary parser does not enforce the 64-character category limit
resolution: Category ids over 64 characters are reported with their line.

title: The findings operations have no Makefile entry
resolution: Added make findings ARGS=...; the protocol and skills point at it.

title: make findings expands globs in ARGS through the shell
resolution: The recipe runs with set -f, so globs reach the tool unexpanded; tested through the real Makefile entry.

title: The NATS seed pattern misses server, cluster, and curve seeds
resolution: The pattern matches SO, SA, SU, SN, SC, and SX seeds; tested through full finding validation.

title: The vocabulary extension test assumes a fixed id is never seeded
resolution: The test picks an id that the vocabulary does not hold and uses it throughout.
